name: Madeira
subtitle: Run Windows PC games on iPhone
localizedDescription: Madeira runs Windows PC games on compatible iPhones using FEX-Emu, Wine, and a Metal graphics translation layer. This is an unofficial listing that follows the developer's GitHub releases.

name: BCD Games
subtitle: Play PC games on iOS — alpha builds
localizedDescription: BCD is an experimental PC game compatibility app for iOS, in active alpha development. This is an unofficial listing that follows the developer's GitHub releases.

name: AirCard-iOS
subtitle: Customize Apple Wallet cards, passcode themes and wallpapers
localizedDescription: AirCard-iOS customizes Apple Wallet card artwork, passcode themes and PosterBoard wallpapers. Supports importing pairing files on iOS 18–26 and on-device pairing on iOS 27+. Follow the official project instructions to use LocalDevVPN and appropriate pairing.
